data.one_liner: Jaspr components for Lucide SVG icons
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-generated Jaspr components for all Lucide SVG icons. Each icon can be customized with width, height, viewBox and SVG attributes.
use_when: You need a large set of vector icons in a Jaspr web project
You want to customize icon size or stroke color directly in JSX-like syntax
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter app
You need icons that are not part of Lucide
You require runtime icon generation or dynamic icon sets
strengths: Easy to import via single export
weaknesses: Only works with Jaspr, not Flutter
No support for icon theming beyond attributes
data.setup_notes: Add jaspr_lucide and jaspr to pubspec, run dart pub get
